spans.s: कु-पथ m. 1. a bad way (lit. and fig.); 2. a heterodox doctrine.
कु-पुत्र m. 1. a bad son, a wicked son; 2. the planet Mars (where, however, कु means ‘the earth’).
कु-पुरुष m. a low or wicked man.
कु-पूय a. low, vile, contemptible.
कुपूय a. (f. या) Despised mean, contemptible.
कुपूय a. (f. या) Despised mean, contemptible.
कु-प्रिय a. disagreeable, contemptible, low.
कु-प्लव m. a bad boat, कुप्लवैः संतरन् जलम् M.ix.161.

कुप् vi. 4P (pp. कुपित) 1. To be excited, to get strength, e.g. दोषाः प्रकुप्यंति; 2. to be angry (generally with the dative of the person who is the object of anger, but sometimes with the acc. or gen. also), चुकोप तस्मै स भृशम् R.iii.56, Sr.

.With अति-, to be angry, Bt.xv.55.With परि-, to be angry.With प्र-, 1. to be excited, to get strength; 2. to be angry, निमित्तमुद्दिश्य हि यः प्रकुप्यति ध्रुवं स तस्यापगमे प्रशाम्यति Panch.i.With सम्-, to be angry.
कुपिंद m. See कुविंद.
कुविं(पिं)द m. 1. A weaver, कुविंदस्त्वं तावत्पटयसि गुणग्राममभितः K.Pr.vii.; 2. a name of the weaver caste.
कुपिनिन् m. A fisherman.
कुपिनी f. A kind of net for catching small fish.
कुप्य n. A base metal, any metal but silver and gold, M.vii.96, x.113.
कूप m. 1. A well, कूपे पश्य पयोनिधावपि घटो गृह्णाति तुल्यं जलम् Bhartr.ii.49, Rt.i.23, Bh.V.i.9, M.iv.202; 2. a hole, a hollow, a cave; 3. a leather oil-vessel; 4. a mast, क्षोणीनौकूपदंडः D.K.
कूप-अंक, -अंग m. horripilation.
कूप-अंक, -अंग m. horripilation.
कूप-कच्छप m. 1. a tortoise in a well (lit.); 2. an inexperienced person who never leaves home (fig.).

कूपक m. 1. A hole, a cave; 2. the hollow below the loins; 3. a well; 4. a stake to which a boat is moored; 5. the mast of a vessel; 6. a funeral pile; 7. a leather oil-vessel; 8. a rock or tree in the midst of a river.
कूपा(वा)र m. The ocean.
कूपी f. 1. A small well; 2. a flask.
